newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine tax inspectors raid city airport.
newsitem.headline: Argentine tax inspectors raid city airport.

text.p: Argentine tax inspectors swept through the metropolitan airport Wednesday morning searching shops, storage facilities and hangars used for air taxis and private jets, local news agencies said.

The raid -- conducted by more than 300 officials from the DGI tax service, the air force and the customs and immigrations services -- included checks on luggage from flights arriving "from areas with high rates of smuggling and drug-trafficking," airport authorities said.
Tax officials said they were looking for irregularities in contracts to lease shops and facilities at the Jorge Newbery airport and for signs of smuggling and tax evasion.
Police also began checking the identity documents and permits of taxi drivers who work inside the premises and are renowned for overcharging passengers from the interior or foreigners.
The head of the airport, Air Commodore Jorge Carnevalini, told reporters he would "not allow anybody to run any services or concession in an irregular fashion inside the airport."
